text: In a Japanese city, a salaryman runs down a young man who has been pushing scrap metal into his own wounds, and soon after he finds [a metal thorn growing out of his cheek|images|wounded and changing bodies] while shaving. A woman with metal tentacles chases him through a subway station, metal scabs spread across his skin, and [his body becomes a machine|threat|the body turning monstrous] that destroys his girlfriend. The man he hit, now telepathic, promises him [a new world of metal|wants|spreading and taking over].
